tei:div.tei:p: The “Prayer for North American Jews on the 75th Anniversary of Israel’s Founding” was first published and disseminated from the website of T’ruah, via PDF here for Yom ha-Atsma’ut in the year 2023.

I have transcribed the text from the PDF, modifying the layout slightly so as to set the Hebrew phrasing side-by-side with its English translation. I have also added some missing niqud and English translation along with notation where citation references are significant. –Aharon Varady
